spec.method: for each flagged (era, drop): monthly dropped-book minus full-book contribution under the additive reading (delta_sum) and under the multiplicative link (delta_link)
spec.units: monthly contributions in return units, gaps and effects in bp
spec.carrier_def: share of total |gap| held by the largest month; at or above the floor the reversal is named a single-month carrier, below it a dispersion

honest: the flagged (era, drop) set is read from the published E183 face, not re-derived here; a missing face publishes zero pairs rather than an invented set
the two monthly columns are the same month return under two readings, so their difference is definitional and does not shrink with more data
a carrier month is a date inside the era's decision months, not a tradable opportunity
descriptive census only: no gate, no prereg, no trial count
